name: streaksync
description: StreakSync: Chrome extension, website and Cloudflare Worker

scripts.lint: npm --prefix website run lint && node scripts/check-extension.mjs
scripts.check: prettier --check . && npm --prefix website run check && node scripts/check-extension.mjs && npm test
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy website/out --project-name streaksync --branch main
